semantics.precision_scope: One literal county Site address point at the exact operator-defined DFW10 address, used to locate the single Red Oak campus. Not a surveyed building point, boundary, centroid, entrance or observed work footprint; decimal digits retain computational precision only.
semantics.horizontal_uncertainty_unknown_reason: County supplies no numeric positional accuracy for this Site address point. Four-metre transformation operation accuracy is not feature accuracy.

literal_facts: DataBank's July26 company article reports current construction at Red Oak and explicitly identifies first-phase DFW9–DFW12.
The operator campus and DFW10 facility pages bind DFW10 to 3330 Batchler Road, Red Oak TX75154.
County address OID70622 matches that exact address and has Site placement; no landmark or parcel identifier is supplied.

The undated Yates case study independently identifies its DFW10 project in Red Oak. Its described construction sequencing and 2027 target have no verified publication or event date and are not transferred to July 26.
campus_association.analyst_reconciliation: The county numeric point is associated with DataBank by the exact operator-published DFW10 address, not by a literal county DataBank label. DFW10 supplies a constituent-campus locator. The dated current-work observation applies to the first-phase campus scope and therefore uses a new first-phase-current-build project key, not a refreshed DFW10 building status.

distinctness_review.method: All selected campus names/keys reviewed; prior sources and research/expansion-200 alias inventory searched. Shapely 2.1.2 intersects() compares the transformed selected point with every full selected geometry including holes.
distinctness_review.preservation: Existing campus stable key retained. New first-phase-current-build project key represents the dated first-phase observation without rewriting or selecting historical DFW9, DFW10 or DFW11 rows. One campus and one project only; earlier stale sources remain unmodified.
distinctness_review.mutual_candidate_check: Only DataBank Red Oak proposed; other round29 candidates remain coordinate-free holds.

successor_review.finding: No authoritative campus-completion or cancellation successor found in bounded official index and exact-campus searches. July26 says only DFW9 is expected online in August; remaining three first-phase buildings follow later staggered delivery. This forecast is not an actual completion event.
scope_caveats: First-phase scope is broader than the one locator building.
Current undated facility pages and September retrieval do not refresh lifecycle.
No eight-building or later-phase completion, capacity, workload or ownership claim is normalized.
The undated Yates DFW10 case study states a 2027 completion target; it is identity context only and does not date construction or a successor as of the cutoff.
